13E1.name: Cape flight slope value
desc: Slope value used by cape flight. Set from the walking-speed code to a per-direction value, copied from X (slope
angle for Mario's pose) by the block collision code, and cleared by the level collision routine.
Read by the Mario pose chooser. Meaning is only partly clear from the code.

13E2.name: Cape/fireball input timer
desc: Counter bumped by the cape hit point and fireball input routine, which tests it to decide when to shoot fireballs
and in which direction. Cleared by the scripted walk (castle entry) and set when a ground jump starts.

13E3.name: Wall-run status
desc: Mario's wall-running state (cape). 0 = not wall-running.
Set by the cape ground pound landing code when wall-running starts; read by collision, pose/OAM drawing,
climbing tables, hurt Mario and the scroll routine.
Values: 0 = none, 2 = running on a wall to the left, 3 = running on a wall to the right.

13E4.name: P-meter (dash timer)
desc: Mario's run-speed meter. Filled while he runs at full speed and counts down otherwise; a full meter allows
the run jump and cape take-off. Normal Mario handling sets it to $70 (full); the cape flight code stores it.
Read by the ground X speed routine.
Values: $70 = full P-meter.

13E5.name: Run animation speed class
desc: Upper bits of the index into the player's flashing/animation timing table (written to $1496 by the walk
animation counter). Set to $68 when Left/Right is held, ORed with X/8 to pick the entry.
Also set to 3 by the level and block collision code when Mario pushes against a wall (probably a side-contact
timer); cleared when leaving the water-border check.

13E8.name: Cape interaction flag
desc: Non-zero while the cape is active as a hitbox against sprites (during a cape spin). Set to 1 by the cape hit
point routine; cleared when the ground speed code cancels it and when swimming starts.
Read by the cape/ground-pound sprite interaction loop in bank 02.
Values: 0 = off, 1 = cape interacts with sprites.

13E9.name: Cape hitbox X, low
desc: Low byte of the cape's interaction X position: Mario X plus an offset from DATA_00D034 by cape pose. High byte
is $13EA. Read by the bank 02 cape routines that hit blocks, bounce sprites and extended sprites.

13EA.name: Cape hitbox X, high
desc: High byte of the cape's interaction X position ([$13E9] is the low byte). The bank 02 routine adds Mario's
[$27] carry into it. Read by the cape hit routines.

13EB.name: Cape hitbox Y, low
desc: Low byte of the cape's interaction Y position: Mario Y plus an offset from DATA_00D03C. High byte is $13EC.
Read by the cape hit routines for blocks, extended sprites and bounce sprites.

13EC.name: Cape hitbox Y, high
desc: High byte of the cape's interaction Y position ([$13EB] is the low byte). Read by the cape hit routines.

13ED.name: Mario sliding flag / slide timer
desc: Non-zero while Mario is sliding down a slope. Set by the block/slope collision code, which reads it as a slide
timer; cleared whenever sliding ends (ground speed code, swimming, cape flight, scripted walks, power-ups).
Read by the pose chooser (slide pose) and by sprite contact, which treats a sliding Mario as a kicking hit.
Bit 7 is cleared by the flower power-up animation.
Values: 0 = not sliding.

13EE.name: Slope direction
desc: Direction of the slope Mario is standing on, written by the block and slope collision code and cleared by the
level collision routine. Read by the ground X speed routine to adjust acceleration on slopes.

13EF.name: Below-surface counter
desc: Counter incremented by the block and slope collision code while Mario is below the surface of a tile (probably
water or a slope edge), and shifted left once; cleared at the start of the level collision routine each frame.

13F1.name: Vertical scroll enable (air)
desc: Vertical scroll helper used by the scroll routine: set from the vertical scroll flag when the air flag is set,
and cleared to disable vertical scrolling. Also incremented once during level start setup.

13F3.name: Mario balloon pose / P-balloon
13F3.kind: byte, also indexed by Y as a bit table
desc: Non-zero while Mario is holding a P-balloon; also doubles as a balloon pose value that makes his pose flash.
Set to 9 by the balloon sprite, cleared when the balloon expires, is dropped, or the level ends.
Block interaction also ORs bit masks into [$13F3 + Y] (X = previous value) when Mario touches tiles.
Read by the scroll routine (adds a camera offset) and by Put Mario on Yoshi.
Values: 0 = no balloon, 9 = balloon mode.

13F9.name: Mario behind scenery flag
desc: Layer priority of Mario's sprite. Tells the OAM drawing and climbing routines whether he is in front of or
behind scenery (climbing nets, pipes). Set to 2 in pipe animations, 3 in Mario Start, bosses and the border map.
Toggled by the climbing net door. Cleared by level collision when he leaves a scenery tile ($8B = 0).
Read by sprite contact tests, fireballs, bounce blocks and smoke puffs.
Values: 0 = in front, 1 = behind scenery, 2 and 3 = special priority (pipe, cutscene).

13FA.name: Water surface flag
desc: Set to 1 when Mario reaches the surface of water (after the swim speed is clamped); cleared each frame by the
level collision routine. The swimming code tests it to see whether he can jump out of the water.

13FB.name: Mario frozen / Yoshi busy
desc: Non-zero freezes Mario and in-level control. Set by the keyhole routine, bosses, Yoshi (busy while swallowing)
and cutscenes, cleared by the falling columns, Yoshi and Koopa Kid code. Incremented by the keyhole exit,
Yoshi mount and Yoshi draw routines. ORed in by Mario's OAM drawing and the boss fireball to test for it.
Values: 0 = free.

13FC.name: Boss number
desc: Identifies which Mode 7 boss room is loaded. Set by the Mode 7 boss graphics setup and read by the NMI, the
boss room tile animation, frame code and Mario's platform/ceiling collision in the boss room.

13FD.name: L/R scroll freeze flag
desc: Non-zero while the screen is scrolling because of L/R camera scrolling; sprites are frozen then. Incremented
by the L/R scroll routine, tested by the scroll code and the Yoshi pose routine.
Values: 0 = not scrolling.

13FE.name: L/R scroll direction
desc: Direction of the current L/R screen scroll, set by the L/R scroll routine and read by the Yoshi pose code.

13FF.name: Mario facing direction (scroll)
desc: Mario's facing direction as used by scrolling. The L/R scroll routine uses it times 2 as an index, and the
scroll routine reads it for the look-ahead offset.

1400.name: Scroll look-ahead memo
desc: Remembers the look-ahead adjustment chosen by the scroll routine (stored from Y). Cleared by the L/R scroll
routine, read by the Yoshi pose routine.

1401.name: L/R scroll hold timer
desc: Counts up each frame while L or R is held to scroll the screen; the scroll starts once it reaches a limit.
Cleared when the scroll stops.

1402.name: Riding bounce block flag
desc: Set to 1 by the bounce block sprite (purpose unclear, probably that Mario is on a bouncing block). Cleared by
the per-frame Mario state; read by block collision.

1403.name: Layer 3 effect mode
desc: Layer 3 (BG3) motion mode set at level start: 1 or 2. Read by the layer 3 scroll code and by the swimming
routine (layer 3 tide check).
Values: 0 = none, 1 and 2 = layer 3 effect.

1404.name: Free vertical scroll flag
desc: Layer 1 vertical scroll state. Incremented at game mode 11 and by the scroll routine; cleared to wait until
Mario is on a higher platform before scrolling up.
Read by the vertical scroll code.

1406.name: Springboard / high-jump flag
desc: Set to $80 by the portable springboard and the cape ground pound landing; cleared by block collision. The
scroll routine ORs it in, probably to raise the camera for the higher jump.

1407.name: Cape flight phase
desc: Mario's cape flight state. Set by the flower power-up and cleared on swimming and death; read by the pose
chooser, collision, hurt Mario and Koopa contact.
Values: 0 = no cape flight; other values are flight phases.

1408.name: Cape pitch input
desc: Remembers the pitch input (cape state for the next phase) stored by the cape flight code.

1409.name: Cape upward boost
desc: Cleared to 0 by the cape flight code on most frames; the next call sets it when an upward boost is wanted.

140D.name: Spin jump flag
desc: Non-zero while Mario spin jumps. Set to 1 when a spin jump starts, on springboards and water exits, and when
hurt out of cape soaring; cleared in animations, swimming, climbing and death. Checked by sprite contact (spin kills),
block collision and the cape flight code (no flight while spin jumping).
Values: 0 = no, 1 = spin jumping.

140E.name: Collision tile counter
desc: Incremented once by the block and slope collision code and cleared at the start of the level collision routine.
Read by layer 2 scroll sprite 0E (sink or rise).

140F.name: Reznor frame counter
desc: Counts frames in the Reznor room (incremented by the Reznor main routine). Read by the smoke, extended sprite
and star palette code to avoid overwriting the platform's OAM in the Reznor fight.

1410.name: Yoshi has wings (B)
desc: Winged Yoshi flag, set by the Yoshi main routine and read by the Yoshi draw and scroll routines.
Values: 0 = no wings; non-zero = winged.

1411.name: Layer 1 horizontal scroll flag
desc: Layer 1 horizontal scrolling enable. Cleared by scripted scenes, boss rooms and scroll sprites to disable
normal scrolling; set to 1 when a level loads (and by the header). Read by the scroll and collision routines.
Values: 0 = off, 1 = on.

1412.name: Layer 1 vertical scroll setting
desc: Vertical scroll setting from the level header (vertical level flag). Set while loading a level, read by the
scroll routine to allow vertical scrolling.

1413.name: Layer 2 horizontal scroll mode
desc: Horizontal scroll setting for layer 2, loaded from DATA_05D720 at level load; cleared by scroll sprites.
Read by the scroll routine (0 = scrolls with the screen).

1414.name: Layer 2 vertical scroll mode
desc: Vertical scroll setting for layer 2, loaded from DATA_05D710 at level load; cleared by scroll sprites.
Read by level start setup and the scroll routine (0 = scrolls with the screen).

1419.name: Yoshi / pipe entry flag
desc: Marks Mario entering a pipe while Yoshi is involved. Set to 1 (horizontal) or 2 (vertical) on pipe entry,
cleared in level start and the pipe animations. Read by the Yoshi routines, carried sprites and kicks.
Values: 0 = none, 1 = horizontal pipe, 2 = vertical pipe.

141A.name: Level entered via screen exit
desc: Non-zero when the level was entered through a screen exit rather than from the overworld. Incremented by the
forced screen exit and the vertical pipe animation; read by level load, level header parse, Mario Start and the
music upload (skips it if non-zero).

141D.name: Level start skip flag
desc: Non-zero skips the Mario Start text and (with $141A and $0109) the music upload. Incremented by the scripted
walk animation when it finishes (probably). Read by level setup and level load.

141E.name: Yoshi has wings
desc: Non-zero when Yoshi has wings. Set to 2 by the tongue and contact code, cleared when wings are lost, the baby
Yoshi swallows, or the level ends. Read by the pose, cape flight and scroll routines.
Values: 0 = no wings, 2 = wings.

141F.name: Level start skip flag 2
desc: Set while loading a level and tested with $141D and $141A in level start setup to skip the Mario Start screen.

1421.name: Tile sequence counter
desc: Counts through a run of four consecutive block types ($6F-$72) in block interaction; compared with the touched
tile to ignore repeats, and wraps when it reaches 4.
